scientific_integrity: The new deduction is symbolic: parity forces the odd repunit factor to absorb the odd prime support, Type B is impossible by size, Type A reduces to the Ljunggren repunit-square theorem, and Type C is forced to length two by a direct size inequality. The included computation is only a finite regression.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes an even base and exactly two distinct prime factors. It depends on the published two-prime classification of near-perfect numbers and does not settle odd bases or higher prime support.
title: Even-base repdigit near-perfect numbers with two distinct prime factors
